patch.value: Unknown-option refusals report the first valid provided flag as the failing surface

A real invocation of pm search with the unsupported --include-body option emits code=unknown_option and correctly names --include-body in its title/detail, but refusal.surface is --status because the shared envelope builder selects the first provided field. That machine-readable contradiction sends SDK, MCP, and CLI agents toward a valid option instead of the rejected one and undermines recovery-closure scoring. Derive the refused surface and rejected value from the actual unknown-option diagnostic while preserving redaction and fallback behavior.
